name: Grower statements
summary: Turns a packhouse pack-out into a grower statement and checks it against the grower's bill in Xero, then queues the grower payment. Crons read and draft; a person approves every payment.

crons.name: statement
crons.summary: Check each new pack-out against its Xero bill, draft the statement, queue the grower payment for approval.

crons.name: reconcile
crons.summary: Mark a grower paid once the approved payment has gone through and Xero shows the bill paid.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations are reads only: one Xero bill by id. Paying a grower is a live operation and is only ever queued for a person to approve.

xero.covers: read the grower's bill, queue the payment against it

gaps: Confirm the workflow steps and platform coverage with the business before enabling its crons.

Xero is the only platform with any mapping, and its guides cover none of packhouse intake, grading, rejects, pack-out totals, pool pricing, grower charges or statement approval. Those steps stay with the business.
ABC Pack, PackManager and FarmSoft are common tools but have no platform docs and have no mapped operations in the kit, so no adapter was built for them.
Sending the statement to the grower is not wired. This job has no mailbox adapter, so the statement is drafted in the store and the email stays with the business.
Recording a pack-out has no command. tools/workflow.ts only proposes enquiries, so the packouts record is written into the store by the CRM shell.
One payment per statement against one bill. A grower owed across several bills is held until the bill is split by hand.
The grower's questions, disputes and the pack-out figures themselves are judgment steps that stay with the business.
The tests run on a fake network only. Nothing has been run against a Xero demo company.
